says: In today's CI, TT8 draws valid job times only from 2026-09-21 to 2027-01-15, so no valid leap day or February to August month-end is ever drawn, and a readQueueWait calendar check that rejects real dates is not caught.
proof: Planting `if (month === 2 && day === 29) { return undefined; }` before Date.parse in .github/ci/time-table.ts timestamp, then `nice -n 15 pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 .github/ci/time-table.test.ts` printed `Tests 11 passed (11)`; restored by sha256.
cost: A wrong calendar rule would silently drop queue wait for real jobs on those dates, starting 2028-02-29.
